architecturePackageMissing.reason: The app-owned architecture package is required.

moduleManifestsMissing.reason: Both shipping module manifests are required.

projectPackageReferenceMissing.reason: The generated project must retain the local architecture package reference.

projectProductDependenciesMissing.reason: Both shipping hosts must link all six required app-owned products.

architectureTestTargetMissing.reason: The standalone architecture XCTest target is required.

monolithicAppTargets.reason: Application targets compile only host, resource, and Metal-shader inputs.

appOwnedSingletonDeclarations.reason: Core services are scoped behind runtime contracts; app-owned global instances are prohibited.

appOwnedSingletonReferences.reason: Hosted bridges receive scoped dependencies and may not resolve app-owned globals.

featureNotificationCenterCalls.reason: Feature routing uses typed application and UI-session streams.

notificationCenterDefaultUses.reason: Only the local media-finish observer registration and removal remain.

unexpectedNotificationCenterUses.reason: Only the AVPlayer completion observer registration and removal in VideoSplashView are allowed.

temporaryApplicationSessionAdapters.reason: The UI module owns the sole observable application session.

productionDiagnosticSinkReferences.reason: Production modules and hosts must not send sensitive application values to direct diagnostic sinks.

hostLegacyBoundaryReferences.reason: Host lifecycle and inbound routing use runtime contracts; legacy singletons, notifications, and routers are prohibited.

hostRuntimeBypassReferences.reason: Hosts must resolve the application facade through the runtime and may not construct or retain the concrete Core application service.

hostPhysicalLines.reason: The host is limited to composition, runtime activation, typed OS input conversion, and neutral root presentation.
